why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Open rafa.ai and check the address. RAFA's official X account is @RAFA_AI.
Browse the leaderboard. No wallet is needed to look.
To trade, connect a wallet on Base Sepolia, then mint test USDC and test RAFA inside the Arena. Transactions on a test network usually need test ETH for gas, which RAFA's pages don't provide.
Stake test RAFA if you want the fee discount, and take a side when a new round opens.
costs: The leaderboard and the Arena cost nothing beyond test tokens. RAFA's X account also promotes a Discord with "Weekly prize draws", though the site no longer links it. The token sale will take USDC on Base with a minimum bid of $100, after you "Connect Sonar and complete the required identity, jurisdiction, and accreditation checks".
risks: RAFA's terms were last updated on 9 October 2026, before the Arena, and don't mention it. The published audits cover the fund contracts, not the Arena. The latest one is a draft marked "Draft v0.1, not for distribution", and RAFA's audit page says "every finding remains pending independent re-review." The sale page promises "No preferential VC allocation", while the published token split gives 15%
